name: Space planning
blurb: Test-fits, seat counts and circulation drawings from your floor plan — usually inside a week.
detail: You send a CAD or PDF plan and a headcount. We come back with two or three test-fit options, a seat count, circulation checks and a furniture schedule you can put in front of a board. Revisions are part of the service, not a change order.

name: Turnkey fit-out
blurb: One contract for furniture, partitions, storage walls and the coordination between them.
detail: When the furniture has to land alongside partitions, flooring and electricals, we hold the programme. One point of contact, one snag list, one warranty conversation.

name: Delivery & installation
blurb: Our own crews, out of hours if the floor is live, with the packaging taken away.
detail: Installation is done by teams we employ and train, not a subcontracted crew who have never seen the product. Night and weekend installs for occupied floors. All packaging removed and recycled.

name: AMC & aftercare
blurb: Annual maintenance, spares held in stock, and upholstery refresh instead of replacement.
detail: An annual contract covering scheduled servicing of mechanisms and height adjustment, gas-lift and castor replacement, and re-upholstery of high-wear pieces. Spares are stocked for the life of the warranty.
